build_head_selection_transformer_model: build a HeadSelectionTransformerModel with encoder and decoder head selection arguments for multi-task attention
build_head_selection_encoder: build a HeadSelectionTransformerEncoder that selects attention heads per task using AttnHeadSelector
build_head_selection_decoder: build a HeadSelectionTransformerDecoder with self-attention and encoder-attention head selection for multi-task decoding
set_task_ids_encoder: set task IDs on the HeadSelectionTransformerEncoder to select attention heads for specific tasks
set_task_ids_decoder: set task IDs on the HeadSelectionTransformerDecoder to select self and encoder attention heads per task
